COMMUNITY-SPONSORED SEAT POOL · LIVE METRICS

Free access is funded by community capacity

Pool Active: 360 open seats
Allocated Capacity: 2,840 / 3,200 seats 88% Claimed
Funded by 42 active sustainers 360 seats available for new developers

How it works: When you download AFWE or initialize a project with afwe onboard, you claim an available seat from the community pool. No paywall is placed in your software: everyone runs the exact same code.

If all community-sponsored seats are claimed (0 open seats), website downloads pause until more capacity is sponsored by the community. Developers can always clone and compile directly from the GitHub repository under the MIT License.

OUR APPROACH

Not a paywall. A partnership.

Tools like React Flow Pro and similar platforms have shown that developer-focused businesses can sustainably fund complex tools. They chose a commercial pro-license model for advanced components, which works well for their ecosystem.

AFWE takes a different path: everyone gets the same powerful, uncompromised engine and full local customization under the MIT License. Sustainers simply help keep the project independent, move faster, and fund seats for dozens of fellow engineers.

OPEN AND INDEPENDENT
  • ⌂ Same experience for everyone
  • 👥 Community-funded development
  • 📋 Transparent roadmap
  • 🚫 No hidden tiers or restrictions
